summary: First full test pass on My Fam. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed against the public preview URL (root, home, profile GET/POST persistence, care get, water increment + upper/lower clamp 0..12, meal toggle on/off, sleep set, messages ordered, chat mom/dad single reply, chat family returns exactly 2 replies (mom + dad) with different perspectives, chat persistence, conversations.unread true when last sender is a parent, TTS mom + dad return audio/mpeg bytes >500B, TTS invalid persona -> 400). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) verified end-to-end via Playwright: Home greeting 'Good morning, Alex' + 3 care rings (Meals/Water/Sleep) + nudge card + 3 family rows render; tapping Mom family row routes to /chat/mom; sending 'hi mom TEST' through chat-input + chat-send renders user bubble (sage, right) and a Mom reply bubble (coral, left) with timestamps; Care tab: water +/- updates the ring/count and persists after reload (verified 5/8 remained), meal chips toggle (Breakfast+Lunch active after reload), Slept well button selects and persists; Profile edit pencil -> input -> Save updates displayed name via POST /api/profile and persists on reload; /call/mom renders 'Calling Mom', animated waveform, spoken-greeting transcript ('Hi sweetheart, it’s so good to hear from you...'), and Sound / Talk / End controls. Autoplay-blocked TTS on web is expected per the review note; mic recording not exercised as instructed. No deprecated Expo packages detected (uses expo-audio, not expo-av). Only cosmetic notes below.

issues: React Native web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — emitted by a child component (likely a Reanimated / vector-icons View). Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents to keep the console clean.

action_items: Optional: Replace any remaining `pointerEvents="none"` prop usages with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning (e.g., care.tsx toast uses pointerEvents="none").
Optional: Add a testID to the middle 'Talk' button on the call screen (currently only Sound/End are labeled) for easier future automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 500-line file but well-organized; no split needed yet.
MongoDB _id is correctly stripped (doc.pop('_id', None)) and never returned by API responses — verified.
All backend endpoints under /api prefix; frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds a demo profile (Alex), a seeded care log (3 water, breakfast, slept_well=true, 7h) and 9 seed messages on first boot. Tests created temporary TEST_ meals and TEST_ messages; TEST_ meal toggled back off. Profile temporarily changed then reverted to 'Alex'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses testIDs: home-greeting, home-profile-btn, home-care-details, home-nudge, home-chat-{mom|dad|family}, chats-row-{mom|dad|family}, water-plus, water-minus, meal-{Breakfast|Lunch|Dinner|Snack}, sleep-well, sleep-poor, care-toast, profile-name, profile-name-edit, profile-name-input, profile-name-save, profile-haptics-toggle, chat-input, chat-send. Direct routes: /chat/mom, /chat/dad, /chat/family, /call/mom, /call/dad, /care, /profile, /chats. Backend is at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + /api. Autoplay/mic on web are not testable — verify UI state only.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing tests. The single console warning about pointerEvents is a React-Native-Web deprecation, not a functional bug.
